# Copilot reviews

Follow `Code Review Rules` in root `AGENTS.md` and read
`skills/origin89-review/SKILL.md` from this checkout. These are the canonical
engineering skills; do not install a published cache over them.

Prioritize bootstrap data preservation, workflow permissions, and whether
consumers can actually load the guidance. Check callers and existing guards
before reporting a defect. Give the trigger, consequence, and precise location;
avoid speculative or duplicate findings. Leave formatting and metadata to CI.
State which checks ran and which evidence is missing. A review request does not
authorize code changes or publication.
